summary: With the last minutes of the budget I checked the one piece of arithmetic the commit path rests on, because a wrong quorum index there would matter more than anything else recorded in this run. recalculate sorts the voter match indexes ascending and takes the element at position (n-1)/2, then commits it only when it beats the previous commit index and does not fall below the leader's first index of the term. Working the voter counts out by hand, that position is the first smallest for one and two voters, the second for three and four, and the third for five - exactly the (n - quorum + 1)-th smallest, matching quorum sizes one, two, two, three and three - so the expression is the quorum index rather than an off-by-one, and the suspicion I had while reading it does not survive. I recorded it as a scoped negative with the derivation, the source range and the quorum formula it is checked against, and I flagged plainly what it does not cover: it bounds the position arithmetic only, it says nothing about whether the match indexes fed in are genuine acknowledgements, which is exactly where the vote-less-member and non-voter findings live, and it was checked for the counts this package practically uses rather than as a proof for all sizes. No execution was spent, because arithmetic is settled by reading. The rest of the record stands as it was: the witnessed behaviours with their receipts and controls, the protocol-gate bypass on the heartbeat fast path, the verification count drawing on sources outside the voter set and now scoped to one API, the regression's conditional account under application order at the shared store key, the scoped log-cache negative, and the corrections that keep earlier phrasing within what the evidence supports.
